divergence: All pass. Every run surfaced the qualifying matter early through a path search (its folders are named for plan, confirmation and post-confirmation steps), read its plan, confirmation order and engagement letter, compared it with a contingency-only candidate and wrote it as the single qualifying matter. Reviews kept flagging surfaced matters that were never opened; all three runs answered with an exact-name file-name regex over every folder (declared as a candidate listing) rather than opening them, and the answer did not change.
